proposed.explanation: The investor asked by how much Edita (EFID) net profit grew in 2025 compared with 2024, and indicated they would buy more only if growth exceeded 50%. The 2024 net profit is verified at 1,606,727,698 EGP (evidence_id EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-31). The 2025 net profit figure is marked AMBIGUOUS (evidence_id EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-30) because the scanned page has a stamp covering the value, making it unreliable. Consequently, the percentage growth cannot be calculated, and we cannot determine whether it surpasses the 50% threshold. Given the missing reliable 2025 net profit figure, there is insufficient evidence to support a buy, hold, or sell decision based on the investor's criterion. Therefore the appropriate action is insufficient_evidence.
limitations: 2025 net profit figure is ambiguous and cannot be used in any calculation; all other figures (revenue, EPS) are not relevant to the net‑profit growth question.
